featured_reviews.name: Komal Auti
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a second-year engineering student, and my journey at the IGNITE Event Fashion Show was truly one of the most memorable experiences of my college life.
During the IGNITE event organized by our college, a fashion show was arranged, and I got the opportunity to participate in it. For our choreography, Kristina Ma’am and Pushpen Sir were appointed as our mentors. From 21st January to 31st January, we trained under their guidance, and the experience of working with them was absolutely fabulous. It was my first time participating in such a grand event, and throughout the journey, I felt myself growing more confident day by day.
Day 1
On the very first day, I had no prior experience and no clear idea about choreography or stage performance. However, once the practice began, Kristina Ma’am made everything feel comfortable. Slowly and steadily, she helped us build confidence. She is extremely calm, patient, and supportive. Even when we made mistakes repeatedly, she never scolded us. Instead, she focused on correcting us and teaching us again with the same dedication and positivity.
Day 2
On the second day, Ma’am helped everyone with costume practice as well. The practice sessions were continuous and intense, but neither Ma’am nor Sir ever showed tiredness. They practiced with us, put in equal effort, and stayed till late hours. Even while returning home late at night, they remained energetic and motivating, which inspired us even more.
Day 3
On the third day, I personally faced a bit of weakness and low confidence. Because of that, I sometimes forgot steps during practice. Kristina Ma’am noticed this and personally asked me if I was facing any problem. She encouraged me to share openly and assured me that we would work through it together. That support meant a lot to me. With every passing day, my confidence kept increasing. We practiced continuously for 4–5 hours, and since Ma’am and Sir practiced alongside us, the entire process felt enjoyable and motivating.
Day 4 & Day 5
During the last two days, several complications and challenges came up. However, Kristina Ma’am handled every situation very smartly and calmly. She encouraged us to stay focused and give our best despite the difficulties. Her motivation pushed us to practice with even more dedication and energy.
Day 6 – Final Day
The final day was truly the best and most exciting day. After so many days of hard work, our efforts were finally going to show results. Ma’am helped us with costumes, makeup, and overall presentation. Even when some costumes were not ready on time, she managed everything perfectly.
The most amazing part of the performance was the final dance, where we performed together with Sir and Ma’am. The performance was powerful, energetic, and truly a stage-breaking one. The result we had worked so hard for came out exactly the way we hoped.

This entire journey with the Dance and Fitness Team was more than just a performance—it was a lesson in confidence, discipline, teamwork, and dedication. I am extremely grateful to Kristina Ma’am and Pushpen Sir for their guidance, patience, and constant support.
This experience will always hold a special place in my heart and will remain one of the best memories of my college life.

-komal auti
Smt indira gandhi college of engineering
Se mechanical

featured_reviews.review_text: Joined a month ago and the team really created a safe space and a good environment to workout in. The trainers work with you as a team on your goals and incorporate your abilities and skills in your training, truly making your training personal and unique for you.

featured_reviews.name: Rahim Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: Great gym with excellent equipment and a positive vibe. The trainers are knowledgeable and always ready to help. Clean space, good crowd, and motivating atmosphere. Perfect place to stay consistent and fit 💪

featured_reviews.name: Deepika Kaushik
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am currently a member at Talwalkars Gym Malad West. The gym is spacious, well maintained, and has a good crowd.

This is a shoutout to my gym guru, personal trainer (PT) Sagar Geed for his guidance during my PT was excellent. I was a bit skeptical when the team assigned him to me but he made sure i was comfortable and pushed me to do more every session which actually got me into the groove. He is soft-spoken, highly driven and committed. His willingness to accommodate my sessions after his working hours does truly stand out.
I would definitely recommend PT with him. #teamwolves

featured_reviews.name: ANKUR JAIN
featured_reviews.review_text:
"The fitness center has everything I need – from a wide range of machines to free weights. The equipment is always clean and well-maintained, and the atmosphere really keeps me motivated. The staff are friendly and always ready to help."

"I love training here! Whether you’re a beginner or experienced, the variety of equipment caters to all levels. The place is spotless, and the staff make you feel welcome and supported."

"A great gym experience! The motivating environment, top-quality equipment, and helpful staff make working out something I look forward to every day."

featured_reviews.name: Abhijeet Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text:
The gym machines and workout area are really good, and the overall space is quite nice. However, the biggest issue is the air conditioning. The ACs barely work, and there is too much heat inside the gym during workouts. It feels like the ACs are just for namesake, with very little airflow coming out of them. For such a big gym, the cooling system should definitely be much better.
Whenever members complain about the AC, the gym staff simply say that the AC is working fine and that they themselves are feeling cold. But in reality, most people working out still feel excessive heat and discomfort inside the gym.

featured_reviews.name: Abhitanshu Raj
featured_reviews.review_text: Fit Life Malad is one of the best gyms I’ve been to. The charges are very nominal compared to the quality of service they provide. The steam and equipment are always well maintained and extremely hygienic. Trainers are knowledgeable, supportive, and the overall crowd is great, creating a very positive workout environment. I’ve now shifted to Delhi and truly miss this gym. Anyone living in Malad or nearby should definitely join without a second thought!

featured_reviews.name: Sudesh Gugale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Spread in around 5k square feet with almost all modern equipments, ample space for consultation and sitting, steam available for all members(M-W-F for women and T-T-S for men), Spacious changing room with lockers.
One can get proper training as around 5-6 personal as well as general certified trainers with good knowledge are always available on floor.
Personal Training is bit costly as compared to other Gym.
Gym Manager Mr. Deepak is very humble and helpful.

featured_reviews.name: Darsh Mashru
featured_reviews.review_text: The gym is very spacious. The staff is also really friendly and good here. The trainers are also really good and helpful and help you in creating personalised training plans.
